used.title: Used

HopDetail.description:
One traceroute hop: the router that answered at this TTL.

`ip` is only ever a public address. A router inside the node operator's own network (or any
other non-public address) is reported as `private` with no address, so a result never
discloses the layout of someone's LAN.
HopDetail.title: HopDetail

HttpDetail.description:
What one HTTP request found. Times are microseconds, measured on the node.

`total_us` covers the whole exchange, redirects included. The phases (`dns_us`, `connect_us`,
`tls_us`, `ttfb_us`) and `tls` belong to the final request, whose address is `final_host`.
HttpDetail.title: HttpDetail

strength.description: A heuristic label, not a probability or a radius; those would need calibration
strength.title: Strength

MeasurementOptions.description: The settings a measurement was run with; which ones are present depends on its kind.
MeasurementOptions.title: MeasurementOptions

NodeInfo.description: What a result needs to say about the node that produced it (frozen at task creation).

RedirectHop.description: A redirect that was followed or stopped at. Never carries a query string.
RedirectHop.title: RedirectHop

credential.description: Shown once. The node must be reconfigured with it.
credential.title: Credential

RuntimeSettingsUpdate.description: Every field optional: only the ones that are sent change.
RuntimeSettingsUpdate.title: RuntimeSettingsUpdate

ping and tcp: probes sent and answered. http: the one request. traceroute: hops probed and
